rules.name: Chatbot preface
rules.description: Wrapper text left by an assistant before the actual draft.
rules.message: The response wrapper was copied into the document.
rules.suggestion: Delete the wrapper and keep the draft itself.

rules.name: Chatbot sign-off
rules.description: Generic assistant offer or courtesy line after the requested text.
rules.message: A generic assistant sign-off remains in the document.
rules.suggestion: Remove it unless the sender genuinely intends to say it.

patterns: ^\s*(?:i hope this helps!?|let me know if (?:you(?:'d| would) like|there(?:'s| is) anything else).*)\s*$

rules.name: Internal citation artifact
rules.description: Tool-call IDs and assistant-only citation markers should never reach published copy.
rules.message: The text contains an internal or assistant-specific citation artifact.
rules.suggestion: Replace it with a real citation or remove the artifact after checking the source.

rules.name: Unresolved placeholder
rules.description: Template placeholders make a draft look finished while key information is missing.
rules.message: A placeholder has not been resolved.
rules.suggestion: Supply the missing fact or remove the sentence; do not invent it.

rules.name: Over-agreeable assistant opening
rules.description: Chat assistants often begin with praise that contributes nothing to the answer.
rules.message: The opening praises the prompt instead of starting with the substance.
rules.suggestion: Start with the answer or the concrete situation.
